title: Predicting skin irritation, corrosion, and sensitization potential of nanomaterials using OECD-validated new approach methodologies (NAMs)
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00955C, Paper

Olivia Lautan, Yu-Ying Chen, Yung-Hsuan Cheng, Ssu-Ning Chen, Hsiu-Ling Chen, Hsien-Jen Cheng, Rong-Jane Chen, Ying-Jan Wang
Nanomaterials are increasingly used in consumer and industrial products, raising safety concerns. This study evaluates the applicability and limitations of current standardized OECD TGs for assessing the potential skin toxicity of metal-based NPs.
